findings.summary: Predictive State Representations encode dynamical state as predictions of future observable tests rather than nominal hidden state. A future R2 survival would not exclude a low-dimensional target-blind predictive-state reduction.
sources: Littman, Sutton & Singh, Predictive Representations of State, NeurIPS 2001
Singh, James & Rudary, Predictive State Representations: A New Theory for Modeling Dynamical Systems, UAI 2004

findings.summary: Computational mechanics defines causal states as minimal sufficient predictive equivalence classes of histories. History-derived persistent predictive state is therefore an established formal object, not a SparkBrain-specific novelty axis.
sources: Shalizi & Crutchfield, Computational Mechanics: Pattern and Prediction, Structure and Simplicity, J Stat Phys 2001

findings.summary: Local causal states use spacetime lightcones and predictive equivalence to discover emergent coherent structures from local interactions without semantic labels. Local/pre-semantic/predictive emergence alone is insufficient as a novelty claim.
sources: Rupe, Kashinath, Kumar & Crutchfield, Chaos 2025, DOI 10.1063/5.0267915

findings.summary: Echo-state/reservoir systems are universal approximants for broad fading-memory filter classes. Future SparkBrain persistence should be tested for genuinely non-fading history dependence under matched recent inputs and a resource-matched reservoir comparator.
sources: Grigoryeva & Ortega, Echo state networks are universal, Neural Networks 2018
Grigoryeva & Ortega, Universal discrete-time reservoir computers with stochastic inputs and linear readouts using non-homogeneous state-affine systems, JMLR 2018

findings.summary: Automata extraction from recurrent networks via queries/counterexamples suggests a principled future workflow: extract a compact finite-state abstraction from frozen SparkBrain behavior rather than manually proliferating one-off FSA comparators.
sources: Weiss, Goldberg & Yahav, Extracting Automata from Recurrent Neural Networks Using Queries and Counterexamples, ICML 2018
